app.title: Meal Planner
app.tagline: Planning the week when not everyone eats the same thing

signIn.heading: Plan the week, even when not everyone eats the same thing
signIn.body: A baby, a fussy eater, an allergy: you end up cooking twice. Meal Planner suggests a week where everyone eats, without doubling the work.
signIn.privacy: We only ask for your email and name. No password is ever stored.

lifeStage.hint: Baby up to around 18 months, young child up to 11. You can change it at any time.

onboarding.heading: Welcome
onboarding.intro: Three questions, then on to the week. You can change everything afterwards.
onboarding.membersHint: A first name is enough. Add at least one person.
onboarding.allergiesLocked: Add a person first: an allergy belongs to someone.
onboarding.dislikesHint: Optional, and for the whole household. Separate with commas. You can narrow it down to one person later.
onboarding.needsMember: Add at least one person before continuing.

home.weekPendingBody: Onboarding is done. The week grid and generation are the next screens being built.

plan.slotIncomplete: This meal could not be completed
plan.violationsHeading: {count, plural, one {One meal could not be completed} other {# meals could not be completed}}
plan.violationsBody: They are marked in the week. You can regenerate them or write the dish yourself.
plan.generationLost: The generation did not arrive. Try again.
plan.noMembers: Add at least one person before generating a week.
plan.planViolationBody: The model suggested the same dish too often. Generate again, or replace the repeats yourself.
plan.sourceLinkLabel: View “{title}” on the original site (new tab)
plan.variantPending: This adaptation has not been confirmed
plan.notPlannedBody: The catalogue holds no recipe suited to a baby under 18 months. Those meals stay yours to make.

composer.collapsed: Anything to note for this week?
composer.label: Tell us what matters this week
composer.placeholder: We're barely home this week, Tuesday I get back late, there's chicken left over, and it's been a while since we had pulses.
composer.understoodNothing: Nothing specific picked up. You can generate as is.

playful.2: Trying not to repeat last Tuesday…
playful.3: Looking for a dish everyone agrees on…

waiting.slow: This is taking longer than usual.
waiting.stillCooking: Your week is still being prepared — it will show up here on its own.

panel.title: {meal} slot
panel.rate: Did this one go down well?
panel.elseHint: Say why: the reason becomes a constraint, it is not thrown away.
panel.reasonPlaceholder: no fish on Tuesday, takes too long…
panel.guestsHint: They are never stored: they exist for this meal only. Their age group is what portions need.
panel.guestsNoGuarantee: For this meal nothing is guaranteed beyond what you declared. Ask your guests.
panel.alternativesHint: Candidates the pre-filter kept and the model passed over. No model call, instant.
panel.alternativesEmpty: No other recipe fits this slot.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.constraintsHint: A dislike can apply to the whole household or to one person. An allergy always belongs to someone.
settings.slotsHint: Tick the meals you want to see in the week. This is a household grid, not a per-person one.
settings.snacksHint: No effect in V0: the snack is a distinct object, planned for later.
